_note: The coaches by the track (GDD 4.3.1, step R4; user 2026-10-09: 'coach personality is key, every coach cannot be the same'). Every coach is a personality with his own words. The club coach of a career is one of `pool`, picked from a hash of the athlete's name (Coaches.id_of), so the same career always has the same coach. Since session C1 (GDD 4.9.1) these four are the voices of the coach records (data/coaching.json, CoachSystem): Athlete.coach_id names the record, the record's `voice` names the personality here; the club coach of a career is the person of his voice (name, gender). All names are made up. A coach speaks only about what he can see from his spot (outdoors in the stands by the 200 m start, indoors in the stands at the rail of the hall; races.json controls.coach). Placeholders: {name} a rival's surname, {split} the player's time at the mark, {pos} the player's place (3rd), {gap} metres to the leader, {to_go} metres to go, {m} metres. talk = how often he speaks unprompted (1 = the base chances in race_commentary.json coach), gap_s = race seconds between his lines at least. dirs = where his wording differs from the default direction of a line (race_commentary.json rules.coach_dir: push or ease; empty = neutral): no opposite advice soon after one another (races.json controls.coach). shouts = the words on the decision cards (card id -> answer id -> text); the default wording is race_cards.json coach.shouts. lines = what he calls during the race: split_* when the player passes his spot (front = leading, back = 12 m or more behind the leader, hard = the Feeling word says hurting or empty, ok = the rest), rival_kick / rival_move (a rival goes near the player), player_kick, boxed, fall, dropped, lead (the player takes the lead), good / bad (a verdict on a choice 10 s later), finish_win / finish_podium / finish_other (when the player crosses the line). finish_part = the finish of a heat or section place that is no medal (decision 43). finish_pb / finish_sb = a personal best / season best that is not a win (playtest fix, 2026-10-10: a PB is never 'not good enough'). story = his one line in the Race story, by case (RaceStory picks the first that fits: dnf, dq, fell, won, won_part (won a heat / section), pb, sb, kick_died, kick_died_late (the kick began in the home straight and still died: the pace before it was the problem), boxed, too_fast, faded, good_kick, podium, better, as_expected, below; sb stands in for as_expected / below when the time was a season best).
